notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Burning Inquiry from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to draw three cards, then create three Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have, then causing each player to discard three cards.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
